reviews.title: Terrible App, Misleading Subscription Practices, and Even Worse Customer Servic
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this has genuinely been one of the worst experiences I’ve had with a subscription service.

I initially signed up for their $1.99 trial, only to discover that the video generation tool barely worked as expected. The interface was confusing, and despite using credits, I couldn’t get the results I was paying for. I remember cancelling my subscription shortly afterward because I had no intention of continuing with such a disappointing service.

To my surprise, I was charged for a recurring subscription anyway. The cancellation process is unnecessarily complicated, and the entire experience makes it feel like the company is more interested in keeping customers subscribed than providing a functioning product.

I contacted customer support within seven days of discovering the charge and explained that I hadn’t used a single credit since the renewal. Their response? They refused my refund because I’d used 92 credits DURING THE INITIAL TRIAL. Apparently, credits used before a renewal are enough to justify refusing a refund for a subscription I never intended to continue.

What’s worse is their complete unwillingness to acknowledge the actual issue. They simply repeat their refund policy without addressing my concerns about cancellation, the unexpected charge, or the product’s poor performance.

I’ve dealt with plenty of subscription services, and most have been reasonable about refunding an unused renewal, especially when contacted promptly. This

Yet for the third day Ike on a row, I get a black screen that says “not safe for work”. I try and tell it what’s wrong and it creates an image of two random Asian women in armor standing back to back! AI art is fun to mess with, but DO NOT PAY FOR THIS APP. It’s not worth it; there are better AI art generators out there.

reviews.title: Rubbish!
reviews.text: Useless app, the picture just appears blank and tries to force you to pay!
